data.title: 法琳 · 秘境温泉中的水汽与羽翼微拂
data.description: 在迷宫深处无人涉足的天然地热温泉里，岩石周围长满了发光的奇异苔藓。法琳浸润在温暖滚烫的泉水之中，纯净的泉水洗去所有疲惫，白皙的肩颈与锁骨泛着健康的红晕。水汽蒸腾间，她轻轻拢起湿漉漉的长金发，眼神圣洁而深情地注视着眼前之人。
data.action: soaking in hot spring, hair tied up, steam rising, glowing moss, tender look
data.lighting: ethereal soft glow of bioluminescent moss and warm steam
data.promptProse: Soaking peacefully in a hidden underground hot spring surrounded by faintly glowing moss, Falin Touden rests in the steaming water. Droplets glisten on her delicate bare shoulders as her golden hair floats softly, her expression pure, sacred, and deeply loving.
data.animaCaption: Falin soaking gracefully in a hidden glowing underground hot spring.
